name: Missing Volume
summary: A library 404 page: a cat sleeps where Vol. 404 should be, and every other book on the shelf is a way out
about: A full not-found page set in an old library under a swaying green lamp. Books drop onto a tall oak bookcase, a sliding ladder glides along its brass rail, and a ginger cat sleeps in the gap where the missing volume used to stand. Search the card catalogue or pull any title from the shelf and it flies out and opens like a real book, with a link to that page inside.
how: The lamp flickers on, the books drop onto the shelves one after another and the ladder rolls in
Until you touch anything it types into the catalogue card, fetches a book and opens it by itself
Type a title or subject in the catalogue card; matching books glow and the first one is fetched for you
Click any titled book: the ladder slides over, the book comes off the shelf and opens with a link inside
Wake the sleeping cat, then ask it to move; it hops away and leaves the library slip for Vol. 404
Press Escape or Put it back to return a book, and use Back to the homepage or Go back at any time
